description: Duplicate ads while keeping their social proof (likes, comments, shares) by reusing the same Page post. Only use this when the user asks to keep engagement; for regular duplication use ads_duplicate. Optional reason is one short evidence-based note for the user in their Agent Inbox. Optional runTitle names this batch of suggestions. Pass the reviewId from an earlier preview or duplicate in this conversation to add the copy to that review, so the user approves the run together. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Allowed (the default) starts the job directly. Approval returns status "pending_approval" with reviewUrl; nothing is duplicated until the user approves in your Agent Inbox. Share the link; do not retry. Off refuses with AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. Post-ID copies never require confirmSpend (it is accepted and ignored). Select ads by Page post ID into an existing ad set or new cloned ad set. Use postIds for discovery or adIds for exact selection, never both. Preview returns sourceCandidates and a pinned resolvedRequest. Ambiguous matches require explicit adIds; warned live runs require acknowledgeWarnings:true or useCreativeId:true. New ad sets: newAdSet and newAdSetPerAd copy the ad set given in adSetId, which must already be in the destination campaign and may be empty (it needs no ads). For a brand-new empty campaign, first put one ad set in it with no ads (for example ads_duplicate of an ad set with deepCopy:false), then call ads_duplicate_by_post with that adSetId and newAdSet or newAdSetPerAd for each group, so the ads and their new ad sets are created in the by-post step. Do not duplicate the ads into the template ad set itself. This blocks until the duplication completes or the 30 minute ceiling is reached. If it returns status "still_running", call ads_get_duplication with the returned jobId until complete is true.

name.description: Name or name pattern. Ad set names support {AdName} and {Index}.

accountId.description: Meta ad account ID, e.g. act_123.

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Explicitly continue after reviewing preview creative warnings. Required for warned live runs unless useCreativeId is true.

adIds.description: Ordered exact source ad IDs. Use preview.resolvedRequest to retain the reviewed selection; exclusive with postIds.

adNamePattern.description: New ad name pattern. Supports {AdName} and {Index}.

adSetId.description: Required for an existing destination ad set. Optional with newAdSet/newAdSetPerAd: omit to copy the source ad set, or provide a template in campaignId and the selected account. A source without its own budget requires a destination template when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets.

confirmSpend.description: Accepted for older clients and ignored: post-ID copies never require it.

newAdSet.description: One shared new ad set. Cannot be combined with newAdSetPerAd.

newAdSetPerAd.description: One new ad set per source ad. Cannot be combined with newAdSet; one source produces one shared clone.

postIds.description: Discover source ads by Page post ID. Multiple matches require an explicit adIds selection; exclusive with adIds.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox).

reviewId.description: Add this copy to an existing review from ads_edit_preview or an earlier duplicate, so one run is approved together.

runTitle.description: Short name for this run. If the user names the run, use their exact words. Reuse it with the same reviewId. A run the user renamed keeps their name.

useCreativeId.description: Reuse original creative IDs instead of creating post-reference creatives.

name: ads_duplicate_by_post
title: Duplicate Ads by Post
